notes: Only warrior/paladin/ranger players pass; every other class receives the exact gate line before any other check (R1/R5e).

A tracker-class player with zero SKILL_TRACK receives the same gate line before the argument is read; no target lookup or draw happens (R1/R5e). The oracle's standard creation dance already grants the skill, so the negative is state-level.
one_argument leaves no target: the exact "Whom are you trying to track?" line with no draws (R1/R5e).
get_char_vis failing prints the exact "them" line; no draw is consumed (R1/R5e).
MOB_SENTINEL on the spawned guard trainee yields the exact "You sense no trail." line before any draw (live); the AFF_NOTRACK player-victim variant is pinned by TestTrackNotrackAndSentinel (R1/R5e).
A non-NPC victim with SKILL_EVASION draws number(1,151) exactly once; <= evasion hides the trail, > evasion falls through to the path (R1/R3/R5e).
Tracking a resolved target in the tracker's own room returns BFS_ALREADY_THERE and the exact same-room line (R1/R5e).
BFS_NO_PATH names the victim through HMHR by sex ("him"/"her"/"it") in the exact refusal line (R1/R5e).
An out-of-world source room yields BFS_ERROR and the exact "Hmm.. something seems to be wrong." line (R1/R5e).

From 8105 with the beggar one room north, the live draw sequence (number(0,101), the failure branch's number(0,5) retries, improve_skill's draws on the success branch) replays identically on both sides; census seed 1 draws the failure branch, whose retry picks the open south exit — "You sense a trail south from here!" while the beggar is north. The success-branch message naming the BFS direction is pinned by TestTrackSuccessNamesDirection (R1/R3/R5e).
A failed skill roll replaces the BFS step with up to ten number(0,5) draws while !CAN_GO, so the trail line can name a wrong-but-open direction (R1/R3/R5e).
When the chosen direction is not CAN_GO (closed door or exhausted retries), the exact "There doesn't seem to be any way out of here!" line prints (R1/R5e).
OUTSIDE(ch) (not ROOM_INDOORS-flagged or sector != SECT_INSIDE) with weather_info.sky == SKY_RAINING adds 35 to the roll; indoor trackers get no penalty (R1/R3/R5e).
The shared improve_skill() helper owns the draw/mutation contract (number(1,200) always, number(1,3) past the stat gate); the live oracle run exercises the call site in R3 draw order (R5b/R5c).
